newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Alpha Finance Q1 pretax up 46pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek Alpha Finance Q1 pretax up 46pct.

text.p: Greece's Alpha Finance, the investment arm of the Alpha Credit Bank group, realised pretax earnings of 1.252 billion drachmas in the first quarter of 1997, up 46 percent year-on-year, it said in a statement on Thursday.
Sales grew 37 percent year-on-year to 1.638 billion drachmas in the first quarter of 1997.
Alpha Finance posted an increase of 27 percent in pretax profits to 3.144 billion drachmas in fiscal 1996.
Sales were up 23.6 percent in 1996 to 4.53 billion drachmas.
Alpha Finance distributed a dividend per share of 200 drachmas for fiscal 1996 versus 150 drachmas in 1995.
Alpha Finance's shares closed 100 drachmas higher to 6,650 on Thursday.
